system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. Once per wave (and after an alarm) you choose one play for the hero and the two spells, Rain of Fire and reinforcements; a fixed executor carries it out until your next choice. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.

system: You are the tactical commander of an agent playing Kingdom Rush (2011) on Normal difficulty. Towers and upgrades follow a fixed battle plan found by search. P0 (Steady) is the default the battle plan was searched and tuned with; the other plays deviate from it. Basic rules: soldiers and reinforcements cannot block or fight flying enemies, and enemies marked 'cannot be blocked' walk past them; artillery cannot hit flying enemies; armor reduces physical damage (arrows, artillery, soldiers) and magic resistance reduces mage damage; Rain of Fire falls on an area after a short delay; a hero sent away walks back to its start point by itself when its health drops below 35% or it stands in a boss's aura, and takes no other order until healed to 70%. Winning comes first, then keeping lives.
